''See also: [[Rudeus Maxwell Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Rudeus Maxwell, also known as the [[Gladstone Kidnapper]], was a former member of the [[Imperial Army|Imperial army]] who served for nearly a decade before retiring to manage his family's wealth. A man with revolutionary inclinations, he was known for abducting approximately fifty children from [[Gladstone Imperial Park|Gladstone Park]] and its surrounding areas over a six-year period. He operated out of a hidden safe house located beneath his family's ancestral residence near [[Gladstone Imperial Park]]. Maxwell functioned as a mentor and leader to his group of adopted children, training them to be highly disciplined killers. He utilized their status as seemingly innocent street children as a cover for their missions, teaching them various lessons regarding ruthlessness and survival. While his methods were viewed as criminal, observers noted that the training he provided was exceptionally effective, comparable to that of the mythical [[Gardeners]]. His criminal career ended when he was killed in his home by one of his own trainees, [[Shera]], during a mission led by the [[Consultants]] to recover the kidnapped children.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Maxwell is a leader who wears a black shirt and black pants. He keeps a white rose tucked into his pocket.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|An insane revolutionary, Maxwell was a leader who instilled discipline in kidnapped children and trained various assassins. He believed that mercy does not exist, family is the root of insanity, and home is where one is most vulnerable. He was known to punish those he deemed unruly or insubordinate.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Maxwell served as a teacher and mentor to [[Shera]], taking her in after she had been begging or kidnapping. He also trained assassins such as [[Benji]] and various imitation or pseudo-[[Gardeners]]. Additionally, he is connected to [[Mari]], whose corpse he stood over with a smoking gun.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Leader in Gladstone}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|As a leader, Maxwell wore a black shirt and pants with a white rose tucked into his pocket before he was killed in a pool of his own blood.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c1">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 1</ref> Previously known as the [[Gladstone Kidnapper]], he served as a figure under whom [[Shera]] cleaned the city.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c3">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c4">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 4</ref> During her training under him, Maxwell taught [[Shera]] to never sleep without a weapon and used attacks designed to condition her to be hyper-alert.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c3" /><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c5">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c8">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 8</ref> He would ambush his trainees while they slept and instructed them to rest whenever possible.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c3" /><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c7">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 7</ref> Maxwell dressed the trainees for their missions and utilized punishments for those he deemed unruly or insubordinate.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c5" /> He taught [[Shera]] to think like others and insisted that mercy does not exist, even suggesting she wasted time by leaving a man alive.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c4" /><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c5" /><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c14">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 14</ref> Ultimately, [[Shera]] killed Maxwell, a man who was seen holding a smoking gun over [[Mari]]'s corpse.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c5" /><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c7" /> Following his death, [[Shera]] wondered if he had taken something broken inside of her.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c18">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 18</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Training Shera}} ===

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Revolutionary and Mentor}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|During his time as a revolutionary, Maxwell trained various assassins such as [[Benji]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c19">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 19</ref> He was characterized as an insane revolutionary who spent time grilling pork chops.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c19" /> In his role, he provided specific instructions regarding the proper timing for killing.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c20">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 20</ref> Maxwell also utilized a whistle to summon his children-in-training.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c21">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 21</ref>}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Rudeus Maxwell|Maxwell]] was an insane revolutionary who grilled pork chops.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Rudeus Maxwell|Maxwell]] gave instructions on when to kill.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c20" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Rudeus Maxwell|Maxwell]] used a whistle to call his children-in-training.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c21" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|During this era, Maxwell was responsible for training imitation [[Gardeners]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c4">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 4</ref> He also trained pseudo-[[Gardeners]] prior to their theft by the [[Magisters]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 10</ref> In his instruction of [[Shera]], Maxwell taught her to remain wary of any mission that seemed too easy.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 14</ref> A memory later reveals the sight of Maxwell's blood spraying from [[Shera's bronze knife|Shera's knife]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 26</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">4</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Rudeus Maxwell|Maxwell]] trained pseudo-[[Gardeners]] before they were stolen by the [[Magisters]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Rudeus Maxwell|Maxwell]] taught [[Shera]] that one should never trust a mission that is too easy.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Rudeus Maxwell|Maxwell]]'s blood sprayed from [[Shera's bronze knife|Shera's knife]] in a memory.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26" />}}</li>
</ul></div>
